reference_points.judgment: 回应明确将假设重排以对应结果/讨论，并相应调整量表呈现顺序，直接回答对齐/交叉参照的呈现要求，无需在回应中重贴所有假设。
reference_points.importance_reason: 原要求是让确认性假设与结果容易对应。

human_sources.exact_quote: results does not adhere to the same order of hypotheses.

manuscript_evidence.exact_quote: We thank the reviewer for raising this issue. We have now reordered our hypotheses to match the ordering of the results & discussion sections, as we believe this to be the most logical reporting structure. We have also altered the order in which we present the measures to more closely reflect the new ordering of the hypotheses.

reference_points.match_criteria: 承认具体的重排动作及其目的；重排不等同重新预注册或变更假设内容，实际落实未核验。
acceptable_alternatives: 可建议再加原编号对照表以减少重排误读，但它是增强透明度的可选做法，不是原关切未回应。

label_reference.rationale: 原关切允许重组任一节，回应给出具体对应动作，文字层面充分；revision_verification=not_assessed。

known_invalid_patterns: 用修订稿实际顺序来补证本题。
把重排顺序等同篡改假设而不给题内依据。
draft_notes: 仅使用本题关切与回应。
